messages.subject: Changing text in legend
parts:
Dear ggplot2 group,
 
I am wondering whether it is possible to change the text labels in the legend without actually change the names in the data.
 
 
Taking the example from Hadley's page:
 
ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity)) +
    geom_freqpoly(aes(group = cut, colour = cut))
I want to know if it is possible to change the text c("Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Premium", "Ideal") to something like c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e") without explicit changes to the data.
 
e.g. I can do this in the base graphic system by doing the following.

plot(1:10, col = c("red", "blue"))
legend("topleft", legend = c("a", "b"), col = c("red", "blue"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 1, bty = "n")
That is, I can explicitly define my label rather than defaulting to the names of the variable.
 
Thanks,
MK

messages.author: 3651c4eb6da83745
messages.subject: Re: Changing text in legend
parts:
As the aesthetic in this example maps cuts to colours, we add a
scale_colour_* and define the labels in there. e.g.

oldLabels=c("Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Premium", "Ideal")
newLabels=c("a","b","c","d","e")

ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity)) +
geom_freqpoly(aes(group = cut, colour = cut)) +
scale_colour_discrete(breaks=oldLabels, labels=newLabels)
